description: This file is a set of shell script tests designed for a Git extension or feature called 'parallel-checkout'. It verifies various functionalities such as attribute handling, re-encoding, end-of-line conversions, external filters, and delayed processing during parallel checkouts in Git repositories.

methods.name: set_checkout_config
methods.description: Configures checkout parameters such as the number of workers and options.

methods.name: git init
methods.description: Initializes a new Git repository in the specified directory.

methods.name: git commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit with staged changes.

methods.name: git cat-file
methods.description: Provides the content of a blob or other object types in Git.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test that expects success under given conditions.

methods.name: test_expect_success ICONV
methods.description: Defines a test with iconv encoding considerations.

methods.name: write_utf16
methods.description: Converts input to UTF-16 encoding for testing re-encoding.

methods.name: write_script
methods.description: Creates a script file (such as rot13.sh) used in testing external filters.

methods.name: verify_checkout
methods.description: Verifies that the checkout process was successful and files have expected content.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of all tests.

methods.name: test_config_global
methods.description: Sets a global Git configuration parameter for testing.
